approach.title: Our SEO Methodology
approach.description: We take a strategic, transparent approach to SEO that focuses on sustainable growth rather than quick fixes. Every decision is backed by data and aligned with your business goals.

items.title: Technical Foundation
items.description: We start with a comprehensive audit of your site's technical health, fixing crawlability issues, improving page speed, and ensuring search engines can properly index your content.

items.title: Keyword Strategy
items.description: We research and prioritize keywords based on search volume, competition, and buyer intent, focusing on terms that drive qualified traffic and conversions.

items.title: Content Optimization
items.description: We optimize existing content and develop new pages that answer your audience's questions, establish topical authority, and earn organic visibility over time.

items.title: Link Building
items.description: We build high quality backlinks through genuine outreach and content partnerships, strengthening your domain authority and competitive position.

steps.title: Discovery Call
steps.description: We learn about your business, goals, and current SEO situation to understand if we're a good fit.

steps.title: Audit & Strategy
steps.description: We conduct a thorough SEO audit and develop a custom strategy with clear priorities and timelines.

steps.title: Implementation
steps.description: Our team executes the strategy, handling technical fixes, content optimization, and link building.

steps.title: Reporting & Iteration
steps.description: You receive regular reports with actionable insights, and we continuously refine our approach based on results.

differentiators.title: Why Work With Us
